key_insight: Multi-domain AAA-least squares (nAAALS) efficiently approximates harmonic functions in multiply-connected domains and supports evolving vortex-patch boundaries.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a low-cost computational approach for coupled boundary problems in inviscid fluid dynamics and other steady or quasi-steady multi-domain systems.
method: Use AAA rational approximation of boundary conjugate data to place poles according to local geometry and global domain configuration.
Adapt least-squares fitting to enforce coupled matching conditions across domain boundaries.
Couple nAAALS with standard Runge–Kutta schemes to evolve multiple boundaries.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports reproducing known vortex-patch equilibria and evolving new and existing non-equilibrium configurations accurately in seconds on a standard laptop, without quantitative error metrics.
watch_item: Demonstrations focus on inviscid vortex patches; applicability to viscous or turbulent flows is not established by the abstract.
paper_title: Multi-domain AAA-least squares methods and applications
